title: 入流果位（不堕恶趣）
note: 最多七有，不堕恶趣；四不坏净

evidence.pali: ‘‘Yaṃ kañci, sāriputta, jāneyyātha gihiṃ odātavasanaṃ – imesu pañcasu sikkhāpadesu saṃvutakammantaṃ, imesañca catunnaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhiṃ akicchalābhiṃ akasiralābhiṃ, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya – ‘khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoni khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo’’’ti.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “舍利弗，无论你们知道有何居家白衣，于此五学处中行为受防护，对于这四种增上心所的现法乐住，随意获得，无困难获得，不费力获得，他若愿意，可自行记说：‘我已尽地狱，尽畜生胎，尽饿鬼界，已尽恶趣、苦趣、堕处；我是入流者，不堕恶趣法，决定趣向正觉。’”
evidence.english: Sāriputta, whatever householder clad in white you may know to be one whose actions are restrained with regard to these five training precepts, and who obtains at will, without difficulty, and without trouble these four higher mental states that are pleasant abidings in this very life—he, if he wishes, may declare of himself: ‘Hell is ended for me, the animal realm is ended, the realm of ghosts is ended, the plane of misery, the bad destination, the state of downfall is ended. I am a stream-enterer, not subject to downfall, assured, and destined for enlightenment.’

entries.pali: Diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāyā ti, ettha diṭṭhiyo eva diṭṭhigatāni, gūthagataṃ muttagatantiādīni (a. ni. 9.11) viya. Dvāsaṭṭhiyā vā diṭṭhīnaṃ antogadhattā diṭṭhīsu gatānītipi diṭṭhigatāni. Diṭṭhiyā vā gataṃ etesantipi diṭṭhigatāni. Diṭṭhisadisagamanāni diṭṭhisadisappavattānīti attho. Kāni pana tānīti? Sasampayuttāni sakkāyadiṭṭhivicikicchāsīlabbataparāmāsaapāyagamanīyarāgadosamohākusalāni. Tāni hi yāva paṭhamamaggabhāvanā tāva pavattisabbhāvato diṭṭhisadisagamanānīti vuccanti. Iti diṭṭhiyo ca diṭṭhigatāni ca diṭṭhigatāni. Tesaṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ. Pahānāyā ti samucchedavaseneva pajahanatthāya. Paṭhamāyā ti gaṇanavasenapi paṭhamuppattivasenapi paṭhamāya. Bhūmiyā ti ‘‘anantarahitāya bhūmiyā’’tiādīsu (pārā. 27; ma. ni. 2.296) tāva ayaṃ mahāpathavī bhūmīti vuccati. ‘‘Sukhabhūmiyaṃ kāmāvacare’’tiādīsu (dha. sa. 988) cittuppādo. Idha pana sāmaññaphalaṃ adhippetaṃ. Tañhi sampayuttānaṃ nissayabhāvato te dhammā bhavanti etthāti bhūmi. Yasmā vā samānepi lokuttarabhāve sayampi bhavati uppajjati, na nibbānaṃ viya apātubhāvaṃ, tasmāpi bhūmīti vuccati; tassā paṭhamāya bhūmiyā. Pattiyā ti sotāpattiphalasaṅkhātassa paṭhamassa sāmaññaphalassa pattatthāya paṭilābhatthāyāti evamettha attho veditabbo. Viviccā ti samucchedavivekavasena viviccitvā, vinā hutvā.
entries.chinese_simplified: “‘为断除诸见执(diṭṭhigatānaṃ)故’：于此，诸见(diṭṭhi)即是见执，犹如‘入于粪者’、‘入于尿者’等（《增支部》9.11）。或因其陷入六十二见中，故于诸见中行者，亦为见执。或因此等之行如见，亦为见执。其义为：行相与见相似，转起与见相似。然则，彼等为何？即有身见(sakkāyadiṭṭhi)、疑(vicikicchā)、戒禁取(sīlabbataparāmāsa)，以及能导向恶趣(apāya)的贪、瞋、痴等不善法，连同其相应法。实则，彼等只要初道(paṭhamamagga)尚未修习，就会持续存在，故说其‘行相与见相似’。如是，诸见与诸见执，总名为见执。此等见执的‘为断除故’，是为了以根除(samuccheda)的方式舍断。‘第一’，是依数量及首次生起而言为第一。‘地(bhūmi)’：在‘于无间地’等（《律藏·波罗夷》27；《中部》2.296）文中，此大地被称为‘地’；在‘于欲界善地’等（《法集论》988）文中，则指心生起。然于此，则意指沙门果(sāmaññaphala)。因为它作为相应法的所依，诸法存在于其中，故为‘地’。又，虽然同为出世间，但它自身会存在、会生起，不像涅槃(nibbāna)那样不显现，故也称为‘地’。对于那第一地，‘为得达(pattiyā)’者，于此应如是理解其义：为了得达、为了获得名为入流果(sotāpattiphala)的第一沙门果。‘远离(vivicca)’：即以根除远离(samucchedaviveka)的方式分离，成为无有。
entries.english: As for 'for the abandoning of things related to views' (diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya): herein, views (diṭṭhiyo) themselves are 'things related to views' (diṭṭhigatāni), like 'gone to excrement' (gūthagataṃ), 'gone to urine' (muttagataṃ), and so on. Or, because of being included within the sixty-two views, they are 'gone into the views' (diṭṭhīsu gatāni), and thus 'things related to views' (diṭṭhigatāni). Or, because their proceeding is like that of view, they are 'things related to views'. The meaning is that their proceeding is similar to view, their occurrence is similar to view. But what are they? They are identity-view, doubt, clinging to rites and rituals, and the unwholesome states of greed, hatred, and delusion that lead to the plane of misery, along with their associated states. Indeed, because they are manifestly present up until the development of the first path, they are said to have a proceeding similar to view. Thus, both views and things gone into views are 'things related to views'. 'For the abandoning' (pahānāya) of these things related to views means for the purpose of abandoning them by way of eradication. 'Of the first' (paṭhamāya) means first by way of counting and by way of first arising. As for 'ground' (bhūmiyā): in passages such as 'on a ground without interval' (anantarahitāya bhūmiyā), this great earth is called 'ground'. In passages such as 'in the sense-sphere ground of happiness' (sukhabhūmiyaṃ kāmāvacare), a mind-moment is called 'ground'. Here, however, a fruit of recluseship is intended. For, because it is a basis for its associated states, those states exist in it (bhavanti etthā), thus it is a 'ground' (bhūmi). Or, because, although its nature is supramundane, it itself arises and comes to be—it is not non-manifest like Nibbāna—it is therefore also called 'ground'. 'For the attainment' (pattiyā) of that first ground means for the purpose of attaining, for the purpose of acquiring the first fruit of recluseship, described as the fruit of stream-entry. Thus should the meaning here be understood. 'Secluded' (vivicca) means having been secluded by way of the seclusion of eradication, having become without.

entries.work_title: 分别论义注迷惑冰消 Sammohavinodanī-Aṭṭhakathā
entries.pali: Bhedato pana kāmāvacaravipākā atthi ahetukā, atthi sahetukā. Sahetukāpi atthi duhetukā, atthi tihetukā. Tattha ahetukā oḷārikā, sahetukā sukhumā. Sāpi duhetukā oḷārikā, tihetukā sukhumā. Tatthāpi sasaṅkhārikā oḷārikā, asaṅkhārikā sukhumā. Paṭhamajjhānavipākā oḷārikā, dutiyajjhānavipākā sukhumā…pe… catutthajjhānavipākā sukhumā. Sāpi oḷārikā, ākāsānañcāyatanavipākā sukhumā. Sāpi oḷārikā…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanavipākā sukhumā. Sāpi oḷārikā, sotāpattiphalavedanā sukhumā. Sāpi oḷārikā, sakadāgāmi…pe… arahattaphalavedanā sukhumā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，从差别上说，欲界果报(kāmāvacaravipāka)有无因(ahetuka)者，亦有有因(sahetuka)者。有因者亦有二因(duhetuka)者，亦有三因(tihetuka)者。其中，无因者是粗显的，有因者是微细的。彼（有因者）中，二因者是粗显的，三因者是微细的。此中，有行者(sasaṅkhārika)是粗显的，无行者(asaṅkhārika)是微细的。初禅果报(paṭhamajjhānavipāka)是粗显的，二禅果报(dutiyajjhānavipāka)是微细的……乃至第四禅果报(catutthajjhānavipāka)是微细的。彼（第四禅果报）亦是粗显的，空无边处果报(ākāsānañcāyatanavipāka)是微细的。彼（空无边处果报）亦是粗显的……乃至非想非非想处果报(nevasaññānāsaññāyatanavipāka)是微细的。彼（非想非非想处果报）亦是粗显的，入流果受(sotāpattiphalavedanā)是微细的。彼（入流果受）亦是粗显的，一来果……乃至阿罗汉果受(arahattaphalavedanā)是微细的。
entries.english: By way of differentiation, however, some sensuous-sphere resultants are rootless, and some are rooted. Of the rooted, some are two-rooted, and some are three-rooted. Among these, the rootless are gross, and the rooted are subtle. The rooted are also twofold: the two-rooted are gross, and the three-rooted are subtle. Among these too, the prompted are gross, and the unprompted are subtle. The first-jhāna resultants are gross, and the second-jhāna resultants are subtle... and so forth... the fourth-jhāna resultants are subtle. That too is gross, while the resultants of the base of infinite space are subtle. That too is gross... and so forth... while the resultants of the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception are subtle. That too is gross, while the feeling of stream-entry fruition is subtle. That too is gross, while the feeling of once-returner fruition... and so forth... the feeling of arahant fruition is subtle.

entries.pali: 32 . Kolaṃkolaniddese – kulato kulaṃ gacchatīti kolaṃkolo . Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyato hi paṭṭhāya nīce kule upapatti nāma natthi, mahābhogakulesuyeva nibbattatīti attho. Dve vā tīṇi vā kulānī ti devamanussavasena dve vā tayo vā bhave. Iti ayampi missakabhaveneva kathito. Desanāmattameva cetaṃ – ‘dve vā tīṇi vā’ti. Yāva chaṭṭhabhavā saṃsarantopi pana kolaṃkolova hoti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 32. 家家（kolaṃkola）的解释——从一族到另一族投生，故名家家。因为从证得入流果（sotāpattiphala）开始，就不会投生于低贱的家族，只会投生于大富有的家族，此为其义。所谓‘两族或三族’，是指就天人而言，有两生或三生。如此，此人亦是以混合有（missakabhava）而说。‘两族或三族’，这仅仅是教导之言。即使轮回至第六有，仍然是家家。
entries.english: 32. In the exposition of ‘kolaṅkola’—one who goes from family to family is called ‘kolaṅkola.’ From the realization of the fruit of stream-entry onwards, there is no rebirth in a low family; one is reborn only in wealthy families—this is the meaning. “Two or three families” means two or three existences, as gods or humans. Thus, this too is spoken of in terms of mixed existences. This is merely a designation—‘two or three.’ Even if one wanders until the sixth existence, one is still a ‘kolaṅkola.’

entries.pali: 189 . Sūkaramaddava nti vanavarāhassa mudumaṃsaṃ. Yasmā cundo ariyasāvako sotāpanno, aññe ca bhagavato, bhikkhusaṅghassa ca āhāraṃ paṭiyādentā anavajjameva paṭiyādenti, tasmā vuttaṃ ‘‘pavattamaṃsa’’ nti. Taṃ kirā ti ‘‘nātitaruṇassā’’tiādinā vuttavisesaṃ. Tathā hi taṃ ‘‘mudu ceva siniddhañcā’’ ti vuttaṃ. Mudumaṃsabhāvato hi abhisaṅkharaṇavisesena ca ‘‘maddava’’nti vuttaṃ. Ojaṃ pakkhipiṃsu ‘‘ayaṃ bhagavato pacchimako āhāro’’ti puññavisesāpekkhāya, taṃ pana tathāpakkhittadibbojatāya garutaraṃ jātaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 189. ‘猪肉嫩滑’(Sūkaramaddava)者，谓森林野猪之嫩肉。因为纯陀是圣弟子(ariyasāvako)，已证入流果(sotāpanno)，他为世尊与比丘僧团准备食物时，确实以无可指责之方式准备，故说彼是‘现成肉’(pavattamaṃsa)。彼正如‘非极幼嫩’等经中所说之特征。因彼肉‘既柔软又滑腻’。由于肉质柔软之特性，以及特殊的烹调方法，故称‘嫩滑’。天人怀着希求殊胜功德之心想：‘此是世尊最后之食物’，而加入了天界的精华，然由于加入了彼天界精华，此食物变得非常沉重。
entries.english: 189. “Sūkaramaddava” means the tender meat of a wild boar. Because Cunda, a noble disciple and stream-enterer, and others preparing food for the Blessed One and the community of monks did so faultlessly, it is called “readily available meat.” That, it is said, refers to the special kind mentioned by “not too young,” etc. Indeed, it was described as “tender and succulent.” Due to its tender nature and special preparation, it is called “maddava.” They infused it with nutritive essence, thinking, “This is the Blessed One’s last meal,” out of a desire for special merit. However, because of the divine nutritive essence thus infused, it became harder to digest.

entries.pali: 363 . Yadi sakkassa tadā sotāpattiphalapattiyāva upanissayo, atha kasmā bhagavā yāva arahattaṃ desanaṃ vaḍḍhesīti āha ‘‘buddhānañhī’’ tiādi. Taruṇasakko ti abhinavo adhunā pātubhūto sakko. Sampati pātubhāvañhi sandhāya ‘‘taruṇasakko’’ti vuttaṃ, na tassa kumāratā, vuddhatā vā atthi. Gatāgataṭṭhāna nti gamanāgamanakāraṇaṃ. Na paññāyati na upalabbhati. Gabbhaseyyakānañhi cavantānaṃ kammajarūpaṃ vigacchati anudeva cittajaṃ, āhārajañca paccayābhāvato, utujaṃ pana sucirampi kālaṃ paveṇiṃ ghaṭṭentaṃ bhassantaṃ vā sosantaṃ vā kilesantaṃ vā viṭṭhataṃ vā hoti, na evaṃ devānaṃ. Tesañhi opapātikattā kammajarūpe antaradhāyante sesatisantatirūpampi tena saddhiṃ antaradhāyati. Tenāha ‘‘dīpasikhāgamanaṃ viya hotī’’ ti. Sesadevatā na jāniṃsu punapi sakkattabhāvena tasmiṃyeva ṭhāne nibbattattā. Tīsu ṭhānesū ti somanassadomanassaupekkhāvissajjanāvasānaṭṭhānesu. Nibbattitaphalamevā ti sappimhā sappimaṇḍo viya āgamanīyapaṭipadāya nibbattitaphalabhūtaṃ lokuttaramaggaphalameva kathitaṃ. Sakuṇikāya viya kiñci gayhūpagaṃ uppatitvā uḍḍetvā ullaṅghitvā. Assā ti maggaphalasaññitassa ariyassa dhammassa.
entries.chinese_simplified: 363. 若帝释当时已有证得入流果的近因，为何世尊(bhagavā)还要将说法延伸至阿罗汉果？对此，（经中）说：“诚然，诸佛……”等。“年轻的帝释”是指新近出现的帝释。说“年轻”是就其当下显现而言，并非指他年幼或年老。“来去处”即往来的原因，不可知，不可得。因为胎生者死时，业生色会消失，心生色和食生色也因无缘而随之消失；然而时节生色却能长久存在，或磨损，或脱落，或干枯，或腐坏，或肿胀。但天神则不然。因为他们是化生，当业生色消失时，其余三（种）相续色也随之消失。因此说“如灯焰之逝”。其余天神不知道，因为帝释再次在原来的地方以帝释的身份出生。“于三处”是指于喜、忧、舍舍离的终点。“唯已生之果”是指如从酥油中提取的醍醐，所说的是依于应行之道而生的出世间道果。如小鸟抓住某物后飞起、飞越、超越。“此”是指名为道与果的圣法。
entries.english: 363. If at that time Sakka had the supporting condition only for attaining the fruit of stream-entry, then why did the Blessed One extend the teaching up to arahantship? To this it is said, ‘For Buddhas…,’ and so on. ‘Young Sakka’ means the newly appeared Sakka, who has now manifested. It is called ‘young Sakka’ with reference to his recent manifestation; it is not that he is a youth or an elder. ‘The place of coming and going’ means the reason for coming and going. It is not perceived or found. For beings lying in the womb, when they pass away, the kamma-born form ceases, and immediately the mind-born and nutriment-born forms also cease due to the absence of their conditions. But the temperature-born form persists for a long time, continuing in its series, or falling apart, or drying up, or decaying, or becoming scattered—it is not so for devas. For them, being of spontaneous rebirth, when the kamma-born form disappears, the remaining continuity of form also disappears along with it. Hence it is said, ‘It is like the going of a lamp’s flame.’ The other deities did not know because he was reborn in that very same place with the state of being Sakka. ‘In three places’ refers to the places which are the conclusion of the abandoning of joy, displeasure, and equanimity. ‘Only the produced fruit’ means: just as the cream of ghee is produced from ghee, so the supramundane path and fruit, which have become the fruit produced by the practice that is to be undertaken, are spoken of. ‘Like a bird’ means having taken hold of something graspable, having flown up, having soared, and having leaped over. ‘Of this’ refers to the noble Dhamma, designated as the path and fruit.

entries.pali: Puttā ti orasā, aññepi vā dinnakakittimādayo ye keci. Pitā ti janako, aññepi vā pituṭṭhāniyā. Bandhavā ti ñātakā. Ayañhettha attho – puttā vā pitā vā bandhavā vā antakena maccunā adhipannassa abhibhūtassa maraṇato tāṇāya na honti. Kasmā? Natthi ñātīsu tāṇatā ti. Na hi ñātīnaṃ vasena maraṇato ārakkhā atthi, tasmā paṭācāre ‘‘ubho puttā kālaṅkatā’’tiādinā (apa. therī 1.498) mā niratthakaṃ paridevi, dhammaṃyeva pana yāthāvato passāti adhippāyo. Sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhitā ti yathānulomaṃ pavattitāya sāmukkaṃsikāya dhammadesanāya pariyosāne sahassanayapaṭimaṇḍite sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahi. Kathaṃ panāyaṃ satipaṭṭhānamaggavasena sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhāsīti āha ‘‘yasmā panā’’ tiādi. Na hi catusaccakammaṭṭhānakathāya vinā sāvakānaṃ ariyamaggādhigamo atthi. ‘‘Imaṃ gāthaṃ sutvā’’ ti panidaṃ sokavinodanavasena pavattitāya gāthāya paṭhamaṃ sutattā vuttaṃ, sāpi hi saccadesanāya parivārabandhā eva aniccatākathāti katvā. Itaragāthāyaṃ pana vattabbameva natthi. Bhāvanā ti paññābhāvanā. Sā hi idha adhippetā. Tasmā ti yasmā rūpādīnaṃ aniccādito anupassanāpi satipaṭṭhānabhāvanāva, tasmā. Tepī ti santatimahāmattapaṭācārāpi.
entries.chinese_simplified: “子”是指亲生子，或任何其他如养子、义子等。“父”是指生父，或其他处于父亲地位者。“亲族”是指亲戚。此处的含义是：无论是儿子、父亲还是亲族，对于被死主(Antaka)——死亡所压制、所征服之人，都不能作为免于死亡的庇护。为何？“于亲族中无庇护”。确实，依靠亲族无法得到免于死亡的守护。因此，对芭达嘉拉而言，其意趣是：不要因“两个儿子都死了”等而无益地悲伤，而应如实地看待法。“安住于入流果”是指在次第展开的殊胜说法结束时，她安住于以千种理趣庄严的入流果。然则她如何通过念住之道安住于入流果呢？答曰：“因为”等等。确实，若无四圣谛(Sacca)业处之说，诸声闻不可能证得圣道。“听闻此偈后”之所以这么说，是因为为了消除其忧伤而说的偈颂是首先被听闻的，而它也因与圣谛教说相关联，实为无常之说。至于另一首偈颂，则不待言。 “修习”是指智慧的修习，此处即意指此。“是故”，即因为对色等的无常等随观也是念住修习，是故。“他们也”是指大臣桑塔提(Santati)和芭达嘉拉也如此。
entries.english: 'Sons' means those born from one's own breast, or any others such as adopted or artificial sons. 'Father' means the begetter, or any others who occupy the position of a father. 'Relatives' means kinsmen. The meaning here is this: sons, fathers, or relatives cannot provide refuge from death for one who is seized and overcome by Antaka, the Death-maker. Why? Because there is no refuge among relatives. Indeed, there is no protection from death by means of relatives. Therefore, the intention is: as in the case of Paṭācārā, 'Both my sons have met their end,' and so forth (Apa. Therī 1.498), do not lament uselessly; instead, see the Dhamma as it truly is. 'Established in the fruit of stream-entry': at the conclusion of the progressive, uplifting Dhamma teaching, adorned with a thousand methods, she became established in the fruit of stream-entry. But how did she become established in the fruit of stream-entry through the path of the foundations of mindfulness? He says, 'Because...' and so forth. Indeed, without a discourse on the four noble truths as a subject of meditation, there is no attainment of the noble path for disciples. 'Having heard this verse': this is said because the verse, which was uttered for the dispelling of sorrow, was heard first. For that too, being a discourse on impermanence, is indeed connected to the teaching of the truths. As for the other verse, there is nothing further to be said. 'Development' means the development of wisdom. That is what is intended here. 'Therefore': because the contemplation of impermanence and so on with regard to form and other phenomena is indeed the development of the foundations of mindfulness, therefore. 'They too' means Santati the great minister and Paṭācārā.

entries.pali: 345 . Dhammatthānaṃ hetuphalabhāvato dhammatthapaṭisambhidānaṃ siyā sotāpattiphalahetutā, tadabhāvato na itarapaṭisambhidānanti āha ‘‘nirutti…pe… vicāretabba’’ nti. Sabbāsampi pana paṭisambhidānaṃ paṭhamaphalasacchikiriyāhetutā vicāretabbā maggādhigameneva laddhabbattā phalānaṃ viya, tasmā ‘‘aṭṭhahi ñāṇehī’’ti ettha nikkhepakaṇḍe āgatanayena dukkhādiñāṇānaṃ pubbantādiñāṇānañca vasena ‘‘aṭṭhahi ñāṇehī’’ti yuttaṃ viya dissati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 345. 因法与义具有因果关系，法义无碍解(dhammatthapaṭisambhidā)能成为入流果(sotāpattiphala)之因；因无此关系，故其他无碍解则不能。是故（义注者）说‘词(nirutti)……应当考察’。然而，一切无碍解作为证得初果之因，皆应被考察，犹如诸果唯有通过证得道(magga)才能获得。是故，于‘以八智(aṭṭhahi ñāṇehi)’此处，依‘总说品’(nikkhepakaṇḍa)所来之理，就苦智(dukkhañāṇa)等及前际智(pubbantādiñāṇa)等而言，‘以八智’之说，似为妥当。
entries.english: 345. Because phenomena and their meanings have the nature of cause and effect, the analytical knowledges of phenomena and meaning might be a cause for the fruit of stream-entry; in their absence, the other analytical knowledges are not. Therefore, he said, 'Etymology... should be investigated.' However, the status of all the analytical knowledges as a cause for the realization of the first fruit should be investigated, since, like the fruits, they are to be obtained only through the attainment of the path. Therefore, the phrase 'by eight knowledges' here, according to the method that comes in the chapter on summaries, seems fitting in the sense of the knowledges of suffering and so forth, and the knowledges of the past and so forth.

entries.pali: 32 . Sotāpattiyā laddhaṃ, sotāpattissa vā phalacittaṃ vipākabhūtaṃ cittaṃ sotāpattiphalacittaṃ . Arahattañca taṃ phalacittañcāti arahattaphalacittaṃ .
entries.chinese_simplified: 32. 由入流(sotāpatti)所证得的，或入流者的果心，是为异熟(vipāka)的心，即‘入流果心’。阿罗汉果(arahatta)与彼果心，即‘阿罗汉果心’。
entries.english: 32. The consciousness obtained by stream-entry, or the fruition-consciousness of a stream-enterer—a consciousness that is a resultant—is stream-entry fruition-consciousness. The fruition-consciousness that is arahantship is arahantship fruition-consciousness.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门古复注 Abhidhammāvatāra-Purāṇaṭīkā
entries.pali: Diṭṭhiyā vippayuttāni, uddhaccasahitaṃ tathā; Kāmapuññāni aṭṭheva, sotāpattiphalampi ca; Catutthāruppapuññañca, sapāko voṭṭhabbampi ca.
entries.chinese_simplified: 与邪见不相应诸心，以及掉举相应心；八欲界善心，以及入流果心；第四无色善心，其异熟心与意门转向心。
entries.english: The four [unwholesome cittas] dissociated from wrong view, and likewise the one accompanied by restlessness; the eight sense-sphere wholesome ones, and the fruit of stream-entry too; the fourth immaterial wholesome [citta] with its resultant, and the determining [consciousness] too.
